d:
Israel’s election results are out, but the formation of the next government remains uncertain. Netanyahu’s longtime ally, United Torah Judaism (UTJ), may now consider supporting opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot, but it has a major condition. Will Eisenkot accept it? Can Arab parties help him secure a majority? And what options does Netanyahu have to retain power? We break down the political equations shaping Israel’s next government.
Production: Akash
Video Editor: Nitin
